info.name: Agent Elvis
info.plot: In questa serie animata per adulti, Elvis scambia la sua tuta bianca con uno zaino jet ed entra in un gruppo segreto di spie per fermare i cattivi pronti a distruggere il mondo.

seasons.name: Stagione 1
seasons.plot: In this adult animated comedy, Elvis trades his jumpsuit for a jetpack when he joins a secret spy program to stop villains from destroying the world.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: As he prepares for his Comeback Special, Elvis gets targeted by the Manson Family while a covert organization seeks to recruit him to its ranks.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Elvis returns to Vegas and encounters Howard Hughes, a gang of evil spies and a nuclear airplane, while Bertie deals with Scatter's reckless behavior.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: While filming "Change of Habit," Elvis becomes inspired by the moon landing and sets out to try and stop a major drug deal — despite CeCe's objections.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Elvis goes through on-the-job training when the Commander sends him on his first TCB mission to find a possible new weapon at the Altamont Free Concert.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Elvis, CeCe, Bobby Ray and Scatter head to Washington, D.C., for a mission to intercept a file that could reveal the TCB to an unknowing President Nixon.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Before Elvis performs at a USO event in Vietnam, he and CeCe meet an unexpected contact as they investigate the possible use of the mind-control weapon.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: When psychedelic drug professor Timothy Leary gets sprung from prison, Elvis and CeCe trace him to Algeria, where the Commander tries to woo Bertie.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: As an Elvis fan convention takes place at The Peabody Memphis hotel, the singer experiences a wild, drug-fueled trip courtesy of Professor Leary.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: While Bertie runs some interference with the Commander, Elvis tries to find out what Project Tupelo is — and why he keeps having flashbacks about it.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: Elvis tries to stop the mind-control weapon from ruining his "Aloha from Hawaii Via Satellite" concert. To help, a stoned Scatter launches into space.

overview.value: Nel cuore degli anni Sessanta, la celebre icona del rock 'n' roll Elvis Presley vive in gran segreto una doppia vita come agente operativo per il governo americano. Reclutato dal programma di spionaggio TCB, il cantante affianca alle sue infuocate esibizioni audaci missioni ad alto rischio. Insieme al suo scimpanzé Scatter e ad armi avveniristiche, Elvis sventerà oscure minacce che incombono sulla nazione.

translations.overview: Nel cuore degli anni Sessanta, la celebre icona del rock 'n' roll Elvis Presley vive in gran segreto una doppia vita come agente operativo per il governo americano. Reclutato dal programma di spionaggio TCB, il cantante affianca alle sue infuocate esibizioni audaci missioni ad alto rischio. Insieme al suo scimpanzé Scatter e ad armi avveniristiche, Elvis sventerà oscure minacce che incombono sulla nazione.

Elvis Presley trades in his white jumpsuit for a jet pack when he is covertly inducted into a secret government spy program to help battle the dark forces that threaten the country he loves — all while holding down his day job as the King of Rock & Roll.
